market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil near $100 and Fed hike bets create headwinds. US CPI print is the key catalyst. Expect volatility around CPI; equities likely to test support. LatAm FX and copper provide relative strength. Yen carry trades stable per Morgan Stanley but monitor. Holiday-shortened week limits trading volume.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI trade broadening beyond Nvidia is healthy. Copper supercycle structural. Hedge fund AUM growth signals confidence. However, trade war escalation and Middle East risk cap upside. 6-12 month view favors quality, cash-generative companies over high-multiple growth. Retirement planning (529s, Roth conversions, Social Security optimization) remains relevant for long-term savers.
